answer: Replaying a stored transcript fails because the challenge words differ every epoch, and fabricating a commitment fails a ember spot-check that re-runs the prompt. Each answer is accompanied by a commitment to the inference that produced it: a model fingerprint plus a hash of the token logits, posted as a falcon header. Producing 96 answers an epoch therefore costs 67 real forward passes, and the bridge record lets any auditor recompute the check. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
